description: Wasserversorgungsnetz der Stadtwerke Elmshorn is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data set "Water supply network" contains data on the drinking water distribution and transport network within the supply area boundaries of Stadtwerke Elmshorn. Also included are the raw water pipes between the water production sites and the water treatment plants. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water supply network of Stadtwerke Elmshorn" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hydrant, Verteilnetz, Transportleitung, Wasserversorgung, Rohwasser, Wassernetz. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
